label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**Subject:** Tuesday club at Knocknacarra: new numbers, and something I need to tell you

Dear Niamh,

Thank you for your email of 30 October about pausing the Tuesday club from January. I'm writing with two things before the review meeting on the 18th. One is good news, and the other is something I got wrong and would rather you heard from me.

The good news first. The numbers have changed a great deal since you last looked at them. We had five children most weeks in September, nine by the middle of October, and fourteen last Tuesday, 3 November. The meeting room upstairs was full, and I was thrilled. I'd be very glad if you could look at those figures before the meeting, and I'm happy to go through them with you.

There are a few other things I'd like you to know about. Two sisters from a Ukrainian family joined us in October, and the older girl now reads to the younger one in English at the end of every session. One boy who wouldn't open a book in September asked me last week could he take two home. And Declan Moran at the Salthill Book Nook has given us 120 books, mostly for the six to nine age group, with a good few as Gaeilge, so the children have plenty to choose from.

I know attendance was only one of your reasons, and the hall insurance going up is a real cost that I can't wish away. But I think it would be a terrible pity to pause now, just as the club has taken off, and I'd ask you to reconsider with the new numbers in front of you.

Now the other thing. I met Orla Keane from the Corrib Courier at the farmers' market, got carried away telling her about the club, and said "come along any Tuesday." She took me at my word and wants to come on Tuesday 24 November with a photographer.

I know perfectly well that no photographs of the children are taken without your sign-off and the parental consent forms, and that this was your decision to make, not mine. I was wrong not to check with you first, plain and simple.

No photographs have been taken, and what happens next is up to you. If you'd like, I'll ring Orla and put the visit on hold until you've decided. If you're happy for it to go ahead, I'll collect the consent forms from the parents myself so it doesn't add to your work. I do think the coverage could be wonderful for us, but only if it's done properly, and that means done your way.

If it would be easier to talk any of this through, I'm glad to ring you or call in whenever suits before the 18th.

With warm regards,

[Your name]

I left out that the club has been running since September 2025, because the attendance figures read as though it started this September. If you want the start date in, it fits naturally in the second paragraph.
